info.name: Generate Q&A for ID based validation

params.name: customerId
params.description: ID value of the Accountholder i.e. MSISDN - the format must be E.123

params.name: accountHolderIdNumber
params.description: Identification Number of the consumer who wants to register for MoMo or do a Pin Reset. e.g. 8512285568081

params.name: requestIdentifier
params.description: requestIdentifier will identifies the request is MoMo registration or Zero balance pin reset.

items.docs: Validates the MoMo account for performing PIN Reset
